title: HCN2 restores wild-type brain shape in nicotine-exposed tadpoles

fields.label: Label
fields.value: HCN2 restores wild-type brain shape in nicotine-exposed tadpoles

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Geometric morphometrics of stage-45 tadpoles show that nicotine significantly changes brain shape relative to the head, while nicotine-exposed tadpoles injected with Hcn2-WT mRNA do not differ in shape from controls.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: HCN2 Rescues brain defects by enforcing endogenous voltage pre-patterns

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Pai VP 2018, HCN2 Rescues brain defects by enforcing endogenous voltage pre-patterns › Results › HCN2 rescues nicotine exposure-induced brain defects

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: Thus, nicotine significantly changes brain shape, but Hcn2-WT mRNA microinjections restore brain morphology to the wild-type state.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Pai VP, Pietak A, Willocq V, Ye B, Shi NQ, Levin M, “HCN2 Rescues brain defects by enforcing endogenous voltage pre-patterns”, Nature communications (2018), doi:10.1038/s41467-018-03334-5; section “Results › HCN2 rescues nicotine exposure-induced brain defects”. Scope: Xenopus laevis embryos exposed to nicotine (0.1 mg/mL, stages 10–35), with or without Hcn2-WT mRNA

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2018-hcn2-13: needs-new-data, resolvability 0.64

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Geometric morphometrics offers a direct and reproducible test if specimen images are available. Since no public image collection is named and paper figures cannot substitute for raw specimens, decisive analysis likely requires new or newly released data.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Apply the same landmark-based geometric morphometrics to raw stage-45 images from control, nicotine, and nicotine-plus-HCN2 tadpoles, then test treatment separation and equivalence of rescued animals to controls.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Raw landmarkable images and specimen metadata are not identified as public.

Shape equivalence requires a prespecified tolerance.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
data adequacy: 0.27
operationalizability: 0.97
discriminating power: 0.88
analysis feasibility: 0.88
data existence: 0.32

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Shape distance after size correction is a standard morphometric test and would cleanly separate a real shape shift from a size shift. The coordinates required for that test were not released. Example images cannot be re-landmarked into the reported statistic. The claim waits on the original landmark file or a new tadpole series.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Run geometric morphometrics on stage-45 brain landmarks normalized to the head for control, nicotine, and nicotine plus Hcn2-WT. Nicotine should separate from controls in shape space, and the HCN2 arm should not; a residual shape difference after HCN2 would refute restoration.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Photographs in the paper are examples, not the full sample.

Landmark coordinates and Procrustes scores are not deposited.

Head-size allometry can mimic a brain-shape effect.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
operationalizability: 0.84
data adequacy: 0.15
discriminating power: 0.58
data existence: 0.12
analysis feasibility: 0.2
